tagline: Brazil's island-capital lifestyle hub — coastal hops around Ilha de Santa Catarina to Bombinhas and Porto Belo.
summary: Florianópolis sits on an island connected to mainland Santa Catarina, a fast-growing, high-income lifestyle and tech hub with a strong domestic-tourism beach economy. Demand is coastal: hops north to Bombinhas, Porto Belo and the protected Arvoredo marine reserve, plus internal island bays. Legs are short and Pioneer II-friendly. This is a solid standard coastal-mesh starter with growth upside as the region's affluence rises.
